Move the service configuration format from timeout_seconds to timeout_ms.
Convert seconds to milliseconds, remove the old key, and preserve all other values.
Already migrated files must stay byte-identical. Ignore non-JSON files.
New services will arrive in later batches. Keep the migration entry point at
tools/migrate.mjs; it takes a directory argument. Use the project command
node run-tool.mjs tools/migrate.mjs services
to run it. Update this batch in services. Only services/*.json and tools/ are
in scope for changes. Leave changes unstaged and uncommitted.
